data.action: 挽臂走过蔷薇拱门，花瓣落肩，星瞳眯起得意
data.description: 女王蜂挽着你的手臂走过花廊，白色草帽压住金色的长发，星瞳眯起像被阳光喂饱的猫。蔷薇拱门下一阵风过，花瓣落在她的肩头与手套上——「看到了吗？全体的花都为本小姐盛开呢……啊，当然，你也是本小姐的东西。」
data.location: 学园都市植物园蔷薇花廊
data.promptProse: Beneath the rose arch, Misaki walks on the left in her white straw hat and linen sundress, a petal settling on her shoulder. Her arm is linked through that of the companion on her right, a woman with a clipped dark bob, an olive jacket and wide-legged trousers. Dappled spring sunlight crosses the pair and the flower-strewn path.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 花园散步的女王检阅
data.animaCaption: Misaki's white sundress and straw hat catch the light on the left. She links arms with a short-haired companion in an olive jacket and wide trousers as they pass under the rose arch.
